bank-of-georgia-liderator-paid-internshi.about:
Liderator is Bank of Georgia's 8-month, fully paid programme running since 2017. It starts with a training stage for technical and soft skills, then participants work in the bank with a personal mentor, rotating through teams. The standard day is 8 hours but is fitted to your academic timetable, and participants get 7 extra days off for exams.

In 2026 applicants chose up to three of 12 tracks, including finance and banking, business development, HR, marketing, business analytics and reporting, data science and banking law. Selection has a general aptitude test, a field-specific test or presentation, and an interview. The bank says about 78% of participants continue their career at the bank.

The 2027 call has not been announced yet; follow the bank's student blog and careers page in January.
bank-of-georgia-liderator-paid-internshi.eligibility: 3rd- or 4th-year university students and recent graduates (as stated for the 2026 intake). Georgian language and a good command of English are normally needed; check the call for work-authorisation rules.
how_to_apply: Watch the Bank of Georgia student blog and careers page for the 2027 call (the 2026 call opened in late January)
Register online during the short registration window and choose up to three tracks
Take the aptitude test and the field-specific test or presentation
Attend the interview; the programme starts in spring
bank-of-georgia-liderator-paid-internshi.costs: Free to apply; participants are paid for the full programme.

government-of-georgia-paid-public-sector.about:
Launched on the Prime Minister's initiative under Government Resolution No. 177 (15 May 2023, Rules for Internship in a Public Institution), the programme places students and graduates in ministries and their agencies. In 2026 more than 3,000 places were offered; for example the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture and the Ministry of Education each advertised hundreds of posts.

Each ministry or agency posts its own internship vacancies on the vacancy portal run by the Government Administration (hr.gov.ge / vacancy.hr.gov.ge). Selection is usually in two stages: document screening, then an interview.

Check the portal in late summer for the next round.
government-of-georgia-paid-public-sector.eligibility: Citizens of Georgia with full legal capacity who speak the state language and are final-year students of a bachelor's programme, master's students, or have completed one of these stages (Resolution No. 177). Foreign nationals are not eligible.
how_to_apply: Create an account on the vacancy portal (vacancy.hr.gov.ge) before the window opens
Browse internship vacancies of ministries and agencies when the call opens (2026: 1-10 September)
Submit documents for the posts you choose
Pass the document screening and interview
government-of-georgia-paid-public-sector.costs: Free to apply; interns receive a stipend (amount set per the Government's rules).

kpmg-georgia-internships-tbilisi.about:
KPMG Georgia lists intern posts on its vacancies page under Audit, Tax and Advisory. The Tax Intern role, for example, is full-time in Tbilisi, targets recent bachelor's graduates (preferably economics or finance) fluent in Georgian and English, and covers tax advisory support, bookkeeping and tax reporting for clients.

Applicants email an English CV to the Tbilisi HR address given in each posting, with the position title in the subject line. Strong interns are commonly considered for permanent roles.
kpmg-georgia-internships-tbilisi.eligibility: Recent bachelor's graduates and final-year students, preferably in economics or finance; fluent Georgian and English (Russian is an asset). Check each posting for work-authorisation rules.
how_to_apply: Open the KPMG Georgia vacancies page and pick a current intern post
Email your CV in English to the HR address in the posting, with the position title as the subject
Complete the interview process
kpmg-georgia-internships-tbilisi.costs: Free to apply; roles are paid.

pwc-georgia-paid-internships-tbilisi.about:
PwC Georgia advertises intern posts, titled for example 'Intern at PwC Legal Practice (paid internship)' and 'Internship in Accounting Advisory and Transactions / Deals Practice', on the PwC CEE careers portal. The 2026 legal internship was open to law graduates and final-year law students and asked for an English CV, a motivation letter of up to 500 words, law school grades and any English certificates, sent to the Georgia recruitment mailbox.

Posts fill quickly and are removed from the portal, so check the portal in spring and late summer.
pwc-georgia-paid-internships-tbilisi.eligibility: University students in their final year and recent graduates in the relevant field (for legal: law graduates or final-year law students); good written English is required. Check each posting for work-authorisation rules.
how_to_apply: Search the PwC CEE careers portal for Georgia intern vacancies
Prepare an English CV, motivation letter, grades and any English certificate
Apply through the portal or the email given in the posting before its deadline
Attend interviews
pwc-georgia-paid-internships-tbilisi.costs: Free to apply; roles are paid.

state-silk-museum-tbilisi-internship.about:
The State Silk Museum in Tbilisi runs an unpaid internship programme once a year. Interns work in one of four departments: collections, education, exhibition or library. The programme is meant for students of museology and related fields, and finishes with a certificate.

There is no application form on the page; candidates contact the museum by email or phone. Call details are announced on the museum's website and social media.
state-silk-museum-tbilisi-internship.eligibility: Students of museology and related fields. The page gives no nationality or language rules; ask the museum.
how_to_apply: Watch the museum's website and social media for the yearly open call
Contact the museum at silkmuseum.tbilisi@gmail.com or +995 322 340 967
Follow the instructions it gives for the call
state-silk-museum-tbilisi-internship.costs: Unpaid. Interns cover their own living costs.

transparency-international-georgia-inter.about:
Transparency International Georgia runs an office internship programme for students interested in transparency, accountability and anti-corruption work. Interns are placed in the Tbilisi office or in regional offices.

The internship is part-time and is described as volunteer; it is not a paid role. Applicants write by email and put the city in the subject line, for example 'Internship - Tbilisi'.

Strong fit for law, political science, public administration and journalism students who want NGO and policy experience. Check the official page for current tasks and requirements.
transparency-international-georgia-inter.eligibility: University students interested in transparency, accountability and anti-corruption. Georgian language expected; open to students based in Georgia (no work permit route is described).
how_to_apply: Open the official internship page
Prepare a CV and short motivation letter
Email it with the subject 'Internship - ' plus your city (Tbilisi, Batumi, Kutaisi, Zugdidi or Telavi)
Wait for an interview invitation

ashghal-field-training-programme.about:
Ashghal's Field Training Programme gives young people experience in real work environments on infrastructure projects. Priority goes to undergraduates required to complete field training to graduate.

The page does not state nationality rules, duration or pay.
ashghal-field-training-programme.eligibility: Undergraduate students, with priority to those required to do field training to graduate. No nationality rule stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Download the Internship Application Form from the Ashghal careers page
Fill it in and email it with a copy of your ID to internship@ashghal.gov.qa

aspire-zone-internship-programme.about:
Aspire Zone Foundation's National Development team runs an internship programme for fresh graduates with no prior experience and for undergraduates who have completed at least 60 credit hours. Applicants must have a major relevant to the programme.

Requirements: GPA 2.0 or above (or equivalent), age 18 to 30, and professional English fluency; bilingual English and Arabic speakers are preferred. Duration and pay are not stated on the page.
aspire-zone-internship-programme.eligibility: Qatari nationals and Qatar residents who have their sponsor's approval. Fresh graduates with no prior experience, or undergraduates with at least 60 credit hours. GPA 2.0+, age 18-30, relevant major, professional English.
how_to_apply: Prepare your CV and transcript
Email NationalDevelopment.AZF@aspirezone.qa to apply
Include your sponsor's approval if you are a resident
aspire-zone-internship-programme.costs: Pay is not stated on the page.

cbq-student-sponsorship-programme.about:
Commercial Bank of Qatar's Student Sponsorship Programme supports bachelor's students with monthly financial support, a four-week internship each year for real business exposure, and direct placement in a position at the bank after graduation with no job search.

It is a nationality-restricted programme for Qatari nationals. Applicants apply through the bank's SuccessFactors career portal via the Apply Now link on the programme page.
cbq-student-sponsorship-programme.eligibility: Qatari nationals or individuals born to Qatari mothers only. Must be pursuing a bachelor's degree, have completed the second year of university, and have a minimum GPA of 3.00. Not open to other nationalities.
how_to_apply: Check you meet the nationality, year-of-study and GPA rules
Click Apply Now on the programme page (bank career portal)
Contact Learning and Development at the bank (marweh.fooladi@cbq.qa, +974 4449 0074) with questions
cbq-student-sponsorship-programme.costs: Free to join; the bank pays monthly support (amount not published).

cbq-young-bankers-programme.about:
Young Bankers is Commercial Bank's summer internship for school students aged 13 to 17 living in Qatar. Participants are placed in branches and departments, learn banking basics and receive a monthly stipend.

The bank announces each year's registration; the 2025 edition concluded in August 2025.
cbq-young-bankers-programme.eligibility: Students aged 13 to 17 resident in Qatar (per press coverage; nationality rule not confirmed on the page). Parental registration is required.
how_to_apply: Watch the bank's careers and news pages for the yearly registration call
Register through the bank's Young Bankers page with parent or guardian details
cbq-young-bankers-programme.costs: Free; stipend paid by the bank.

cmuq-qsiurp-summer-undergraduate-researc.about:
QSIURP gives qualified CMU-Q undergraduates funding to carry out summer research driven by their own interests, in any field. Students submit a proposal and work with a faculty advisor. A sister programme, SURA (Summer Undergraduate Research Apprenticeship), gives credit for working on a faculty project without prior research experience.

The page lists neither dates nor amounts.
cmuq-qsiurp-summer-undergraduate-researc.eligibility: Open to qualified undergraduates enrolled at CMU-Q in any field; no nationality rule on the page. Not open to students from other universities.
how_to_apply: Open the CMU-Q Student Research and Innovation page
Develop a project idea and find a CMU-Q faculty advisor
Submit the proposal to the CMU-Q research office
Ask the office about the current deadline and award size
cmuq-qsiurp-summer-undergraduate-researc.costs: No fee; funded by CMU-Q. Award size is not published.

hmc-dental-internship-program.about:
The HMC Dental Internship gives new dental graduates supervised rotations in Periodontics, Orthodontics, Endodontics, Prosthodontics, Pedodontics and Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery. There is one intake a year starting on 1 January.

Applicants need a BDS or equivalent from a recognised school obtained within the past three years (final-year students may apply if they graduate before the start), a pass in the Ministry of Public Health DHP General Dentist Qualifying Exam, and an English score (IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 80 or OET Dentistry C+). Applications must be complete, with all exam scores, before submission.
hmc-dental-internship-program.eligibility: Qatari or GCC citizens, or holders of a valid Qatar residency permit under first-degree family sponsorship. Employer-sponsored applicants and international applicants without valid Qatari residency are not accepted. BDS (or equivalent) within the past three years; DHP General Dentist Qualifying Exam passed; English score as stated. Previous HMC dental interns are ineligible.
how_to_apply: Pass the DHP General Dentist Qualifying Exam and get a valid English score
Follow the procedure on the programme's How to Apply page on hamad.qa
Submit a complete application with all exam scores by 15 October
Queries: falabdulla4@hamad.qa (Sunday-Thursday, Qatar time)
hmc-dental-internship-program.costs: The page does not state pay or fees.

hmc-medical-internship-program.about:
The HMC Medical Internship is a one-year (thirteen-block) programme for newly qualified doctors. It includes four mandatory rotations (Internal Medicine, General Surgery, Pediatrics, Obstetrics and Gynecology) and two electives, and ends with a Certificate of Completion of Medical Internship.

Applicants must have graduated from a medical school in the World Directory of Medical Schools within the past five years (final-year students may apply if they graduate before the start date) and hold a minimum clinical exam score (USMLE Step 2 CK 172, IFOM CSE, or MCC QE Part 1 pass) plus an English score (IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 80 or OET Medical C+). Selection is competitive and based mainly on those scores.

Selected interns must be physically in Qatar for six weeks before the start date for onboarding and cannot take leave in the first three months. Applications are accepted year-round with two start dates.
hmc-medical-internship-program.eligibility: Qatari citizens, GCC citizens, or holders of a valid Qatar residency permit under first-degree family sponsorship only. Medical graduates (within 5 years) or final-year students graduating before the start date; clinical exam and English scores as above. Non-medical graduates (nursing, pharmacy) are not eligible. Previous HMC interns are not eligible.
how_to_apply: Check the eligibility and exam-score requirements on the HMC Internship Program page
Apply online through the HMC application portal (paper applications are not accepted)
Submit before 15 Nov for a 1 January start, or before 15 May for a 1 July start
Selected candidates are notified by 20 Nov / 20 May and must be in Qatar six weeks before starting
Questions: internship@hamad.qa (Sunday-Thursday, Qatar time)
hmc-medical-internship-program.costs: No fee to join. Qataris receive salary and benefits; non-Qataris receive no remuneration and are not sponsored by HMC.

kahramaa-field-training-program.about:
Kahramaa provides field training to university and high-school students, for a number of hours based on each educational institution's requirements. Training areas must match Kahramaa's specialties (electricity, water, engineering, administration).

The page gives no nationality rule, pay or application method; contact Kahramaa through its contact page or WhatsApp 30303991.
kahramaa-field-training-program.eligibility: University and high-school students whose field matches Kahramaa's specialties. The page does not state any nationality requirement.
how_to_apply: Ask your school or university training office to contact Kahramaa
Or contact Kahramaa on WhatsApp 30303991 / via its Contact Us page

milaha-internship-program-qatari-student.about:
Milaha's Qatarisation page describes an internship programme for national students in universities, colleges and high secondary schools. Placements last 4 to 8 weeks, and supervisors award a Certificate of Achievement at the end.

Milaha's 2016 announcement said the programme ran in January, April, June and July and targeted maritime, engineering, finance and business majors. Applications are made through an online form asking for name, gender, QID, email and phone.
milaha-internship-program-qatari-student.eligibility: Qatari nationals only: the page says 'national students' in universities, colleges and high secondary schools, and the form requires a QID number. Non-Qataris are not eligible. No GPA or major is listed on the current page (the 2016 announcement mentioned maritime, engineering, finance and business).
how_to_apply: Open the Milaha Qatarisation page and click the internship application form
Fill in full name, gender, QID number, email and phone
Contact info@milaha.com or +974 4494 9666 for current intake windows
milaha-internship-program-qatari-student.costs: Pay is not stated on the official page.

mol-maharat-summer-training-programme.about:
Maharat 2026 was launched on 11 July 2026 by the Ministry of Labour's Qualifying and Skills Development Department with private-sector partners, across sectors including financial services, logistics, manufacturing, construction, education, tourism, IT and healthcare. Participating banks in the 2023 scheme included QIIB and Doha Bank.

It is for Qatari secondary and university students and children of Qatari women who register on the Ministry's website. Dates, stipend and registration deadlines were not stated in press coverage.
mol-maharat-summer-training-programme.eligibility: Qatari secondary and university students, and children of Qatari women, registered through the Ministry's website. Not open to other nationalities.
how_to_apply: Watch the Ministry of Labour website and QNA for the yearly call
Register on the Ministry's website when the call opens

pwc-middle-east-qatar-summer-internship-.about:
PwC Middle East runs summer internships in Doha aimed at students entering their final year, lasting about six to eight weeks between June and August. The posting for the 2026 Deals Summer Internship Programme was titled 'Qatari Nationals Only' and was marked filled on the page. PwC also lists Tax and Legal summer programmes for 2026 in Qatar.

The summer programme repeats each year, so use it as a pattern to plan for; open calls appear on the PwC Middle East careers site.
pwc-middle-east-qatar-summer-internship-.eligibility: Qatari nationals only. Students entering their final year of study (per the 2026 programme description).
how_to_apply: Check the PwC Middle East careers site for the next Qatar summer internship posting
Register for the talent community to be alerted
Apply online with CV and transcript
Complete the assessments and interviews if shortlisted

qatar-shell-internship-experience.about:
Shell Qatar's 'Qatar Shell Internship Experience' is listed on Shell's Qatar student pages. The 2026 cycle was a paid 6-8 week summer programme at Ras Laffan and Doha for Qatari engineering students early in their studies, with applications opening in March 2026.

A 2027 cycle has not been announced; follow the same March pattern and check the page. Details here come from the official page title and the 2026 listing, so confirm on the page before applying.
qatar-shell-internship-experience.eligibility: Qatari nationals who are engineering students (per the 2026 listing). Non-Qataris were not eligible in that cycle. Confirm criteria on the Shell Qatar page.
how_to_apply: Open the Shell Qatar assessed-internships page
Watch for the 2027 application window (about March)
Apply through Shell's online careers portal and complete the assessment

qbri-research-assistant-intern-drc-al-me.about:
A current call on the Qatar Foundation internships portal for a research assistant intern at QBRI (DRC). The intern supports ongoing laboratory research: preparing culture media, buffers and reagents, assisting with protein purification and sample preparation, supporting routine molecular biology assays, keeping accurate records, and following biosafety rules and good laboratory practice.

The posting does not state the duration, hours or pay; those are confirmed by the Al-Meydan team (almeydan@qf.org.qa, +974 4454 0352, Multaqa Student Center, Education City).
qbri-research-assistant-intern-drc-al-me.eligibility: Open to students enrolled at a Qatar Foundation university with a GPA of 2.5 or higher. Nationality is not restricted on the posting. Students on scholarships must check that their scholarship permits work. Basic knowledge of molecular biology and biochemistry is expected.
how_to_apply: Open the posting on the Qatar Foundation internships portal
Log in or register as a student on the portal
Submit the application before 19 Nov 2026
Questions: almeydan@qf.org.qa or mehnaty@qf.org.qa
qbri-research-assistant-intern-drc-al-me.costs: No application fee. Pay and hours are not stated on the posting.

qeeri-summer-research-opportunities-prog.about:
QEERI places STEM undergraduates in its research centres (energy, water, corrosion, environment and sustainability) for eight weeks over the summer, working on a project with a scientist mentor. The 2024 call ran Sunday to Thursday, 8:30-15:30, and asked for two project choices.

The call is annual but the dates change each year; the 2024 page is the latest published one, so watch the QEERI page for the next call (usually spring).
qeeri-summer-research-opportunities-prog.eligibility: Per the latest (2024) call: valid Qatar residence permit and Qatar ID; enrolled in an undergraduate STEM programme with at least two years of coursework completed; cumulative GPA of at least 3.0/4.0. No nationality restriction is stated. Check that the same rules apply to the next call.
how_to_apply: Watch the QEERI Summer Research Program page for the next call
Prepare the application form, CV, letter of interest, two faculty recommendation letters, transcript and Qatar ID copy
Choose two preferred projects
Submit the online form before the deadline
qeeri-summer-research-opportunities-prog.costs: No fee. Stipend is not stated on the page.

qfc-internship-rising-stars-programme.about:
The QFC internship programme, branded Rising Stars, offers summer and year-round placements to students from Qatar's leading universities. Interns are matched to teams that suit their academic background and interests, working in areas such as policy, marketing, strategy and digital innovation.

The page gives no nationality rule, pay or dates; contact internships@qfc.qa for these.
qfc-internship-rising-stars-programme.eligibility: Students from Qatar's leading universities. No nationality rule is stated on the page; confirm with internships@qfc.qa.
how_to_apply: Open the Life at QFC page
Use the Register Your Interest link (emails internships@qfc.qa)
Send your CV, university and preferred area
QFC contacts shortlisted students

qia-internship-summer-training.about:
QIA offers internship / summer training of typically two to five weeks of on-the-job training to final-year college students studying a relevant qualification at a reputable institution.

The careers page does not list nationality rules, pay or dates. Apply by emailing the internship team. QIA's separate Journey graduate programme was closed when checked and is not listed.
qia-internship-summer-training.eligibility: Final-year students in a relevant qualification at a reputable institution. Nationality: not stated on the page. Pay: not stated.
how_to_apply: Confirm you are in your final year in a relevant field
Email QIA-internship@qia.qa with your CV and details

vodafone-qatar-sponsorship-programme-int.about:
Vodafone Qatar's sponsorship programme supports Qatari students at university with financial support and a 4-week internship placement once a year. After graduation sponsored students are employed in their specialist area and can apply to the Discover Graduate programme.

It is a nationals-only programme.
vodafone-qatar-sponsorship-programme-int.eligibility: Qatari nationals only. High school completed with 75% or above; university GPA of at least 2.1; proficient English.
how_to_apply: Read the sponsorship page on vodafone.qa
Click Apply Now to open the Vodafone Qatar jobs portal
Create a profile and submit the application
Shortlisted candidates are contacted by Vodafone Qatar
vodafone-qatar-sponsorship-programme-int.costs: No application fee; sponsorship costs are covered by Vodafone Qatar.
